entries.scope: Fleet-wide Stage-B control plane, serial repository rollout, provider governance, acceptance evidence, accessibility, security, architecture and operating documentation
entries.rationale: Stage B adds user-visible preview, delivery, resume and verification contracts plus security-sensitive remote and ruleset boundaries. One feature-wide decision keeps reader paths, language, platform, distribution and closeout evidence causally reviewable.
readerPaths: Daily user: README or README.en.md to the mutation-free Stage-B preview, then quickstart/manpage
Maintainer or AI agent: script reference to contracts, authority, evidence and stop/resume
Security/architecture reviewer: assurance documents to implementation-governance evidence
Audit/troubleshooting: platform records and task/gate state to the exact safe next action
entries.navigationImpact: README.md and README.en.md now use the validated manpage fragment and lead from the mutation-free preview to quickstart, bilingual manpage/help, assurance documents, evidence and the separately authorized G4 sequencing follow-up.
entries.languageStrategy: German first with English companion content at approximately CEFR B2; stable command names and machine fields remain unchanged.
entries.platformAndExampleProof: T107 examples are bound to T110-T112: local macOS Bash and PowerShell previews, isolated native Linux container preview, and native Windows PowerShell 7 workflow run 32567141555/job 97017306468 all exited 0 for payload 1b7a4602d2d4c7d20cc85573a1ac33ddec5ac65e31f744a508ec8a61598741c3 and decision 70d4e65f1b8e5ab3d167c57f48346a01a41b24e5e1b826910cc0e991ce484897 with zero Git/provider writes. These scoped proofs do not claim the pending T124 full regression or T125 acceptance aggregation.
entries.risk: Live provider delivery, the T124 full regression, T125 aggregation and post-merge Home sync remain pending; scoped platform proof cannot be promoted to those later gates.
entries.reevaluationTrigger: Fleet, profile, authority, bypass, provider, ruleset, platform, evidence schema, distribution, audience, shared guidance or G4 boundary changes.

distributionReview.rationale: Runtime paths are manifest-bound homeRuntime, but synchronization remains blocked until preview, conflict checks, Level-0 merge and fresh authority pass.

sharedGuidanceReview.rationale: The successful macOS-first Linux-container and native-Windows-CI strategy is a durable agent-neutral governance rule. Constitution 1.21.0, both mirrors, all five maintained agent surfaces and relevant source/runtime templates were updated atomically. No provider or model was made a feature requirement.
sharedGuidanceReview.evidence: T121: byte-identical constitution mirror and successful scripts/tests/test_spec_kit_agent_surface_parity.py plus Bash/PowerShell homogeneity validation.
sharedGuidanceReview.residualRisk: A scoped native platform proof can become stale after commit, command, runner, payload, decision or permission drift and never establishes a full regression pass.
sharedGuidanceReview.reevaluationTrigger: Any shared guidance, Constitution, template, statistics-methodology or routing-role change.
